wins.label: DRIVE savings progress
wins.evidence: We achieved DRIVE savings of $540 million in Q2.

wins.label: Network 2.0 rollout
wins.evidence: Network 2.0 rollout continued, and the Canadian market integration will be largely complete in early calendar year '25.

wins.label: Improved European performance
wins.evidence: Our European business is predominantly a ground-based business. We introduced new European leadership over the summer, including a senior operator from our U.S. service team.

wins.label: New sorting facility
wins.evidence: In October, just in time for peak, we celebrated the grand opening of a new state-of-the-art sorting facility at our Memphis World Hub.

wins.label: Strong peak season performance
wins.evidence: So far during peak, they're delivering more packages per day on average while maintaining the high-quality shipping experience that our customers expect.

risks.label: Soft industrial economy
risks.evidence: The soft industrial economy, coupled with difficult year-over-year comparisons, weighed on our Freight segment in the second quarter.

risks.label: USPS contract expiration
risks.evidence: The expiration of the U.S. Postal Service contract negatively affected 2 months of the quarter, resulting in additional operating profit headwind.

risks.label: Lower B2B volumes
risks.evidence: B2B revenues comprising nearly 60% of our package business and 90% of our LTL business, we are well positioned for profitable growth when the industrial economy recovers.

risks.label: Competitive pricing environment
risks.evidence: The pricing environment is competitive, but I'm encouraged that revenue quality actions are gaining traction.

risks.label: Revised EPS outlook
risks.evidence: We are revising our FY '25 adjusted diluted EPS outlook to $19 to $20 compared to the prior range of $20 to $21.

wins.label: Freight Margin Improvement
wins.evidence: Freight has maintained its leading market share position for a long time and increased operating profit nearly 25% on average per year over the last 5 years, expanding operating margin by approximately 1,100 basis points.

wins.label: LTL Sales Force Expansion
wins.evidence: We've already begun to build out this team, and we expect to add more than 300 LTL specialists by the time of separation.

wins.label: Network Efficiency Improvements
wins.evidence: Improved Freight and FedEx network efficiencies, focused on accelerating speed, improving coverage, optimizing touches and lowering our cost to serve.

wins.label: FedEx Express Leadership
wins.evidence: We pioneered the Express transportation industry over 50 years ago and remained the industry leader today.
